sf-trigg.name: Trigg Point
sf-trigg.note: Right-hander over sand and rock, works for longboards and mid-lengths. Perth's most reliable mellow wave.

sf-farm.name: The Farm (Bunker Bay)
sf-farm.note: Peaky lefts and rights in sheltered Bunker Bay. Fun in small to mid swell, can still hit hard.

sf-yalli.name: Yallingup Main Break
sf-yalli.note: Lefts and rights close to the beach, short paddle. Pick a small day, it gets heavy with size.

sf-injidup.name: Injidup Point
sf-injidup.note: Right-hand point at the south end of Injidup beach. Best in south-east wind; Car Parks next to it is busier.

sf-moses.name: Moses Rock
sf-moses.note: Gentle left-hander, one of the mellow options on the Capes. Best in straight west swell with easterly wind.

sf-huzzas.name: Huzzas (Gracetown)
sf-huzzas.note: Sheltered right in Cowaramup Bay, beginner to intermediate, great on a longboard. Often crowded.

sf-southpoint.name: South Point (Gracetown)
sf-southpoint.note: Right-hand point next to Huzzas. Works in south-west wind when other spots are blown out. Busy.

sf-ellens.name: Ellensbrook (Ulus, Noisies, Lefties)
sf-ellens.note: Relatively easy reef waves, short walk in. Avoid the Bombie and Umbies.

sf-redgate.name: Redgate
sf-redgate.note: Easy, mellow beach break, sheltered when other spots are too big. Good family beach day.

sf-ocean.name: Ocean Beach (Denmark)
sf-ocean.note: Beach break at the Wilson Inlet mouth, the local learner spot. Fun on a longboard on small days.

sf-middleton.name: Middleton Beach (Albany)
sf-middleton.note: Sheltered bay beach, small and gentle. Only works on bigger swells.

sf-twilight.name: Twilight Beach (Esperance)
sf-twilight.note: Mellow waves on a beautiful beach, beginner to intermediate.

sf-fourth.name: Fourth Beach (Esperance)
sf-fourth.note: Sandy bottom, gentle waves, suits longboards.

sf-ninemile.name: Nine Mile Beach (Esperance)
sf-ninemile.note: Mix of beach and reef, relaxed and uncrowded, good for longboards.

sf-drummond.name: Drummond Cove (Geraldton)
sf-drummond.note: Wide A-frame, mushy in the middle; go left. Best with light winds.

sf-coronation.name: Coronation Beach
sf-coronation.note: Reef-protected lagoon with a chest-high outer break on good autumn days. Windy in the afternoon.
